name: AI Tutor
summary: An Android app in development that helps students work through maths problems one step at a time — with Hint and Explain Differently — instead of revealing the final answer straight away.
visualNote: Shown in the app's built-in sample mode with the example problem 3x + 7 = 22 — these are not live AI responses. The app currently shows its development name, Homework Tutor.
